about.text: A traditional Czech cheese made from sheep milk. It has the shape of an irregular ball with thin yellow to orange natural rind. It is used as a table cheese or for melting.

sources.text: Made in Karlovy Vary; Wikipedia: hard pressed sheep cheese, ripens two months, thin yellow-orange natural rind
